description_full: Baytex Energy Corp., an energy company, engages in the acquisition, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin. It offers light oil and condensate, heavy oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. The company also holds 100% interest in Duvernay and Peace River properties in Alberta; and Lloydminster property in Alberta and Saskatchewan. Baytex Energy Corp. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

financial_summary: Baytex Energy Corp is a mid-cap energy business with a $2.9B market cap on $1.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -16% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 11% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically.
Accruals are elevated at -62.5% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 0.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.4% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
